desc: Derive the cost expression: for each v, c_v = 1 + #{u<v : pos[u] < pos[v]}, cost(v) = sum_{i=c_v}^{v-1} i = T(v-1) - T(c_v-1); confirmed matches samples.
Implement O(N log N) Fenwick-over-positions solution and compute the triangular-sum answer; handles N up to 2e5 and large 64-bit answer.
Validate the implementation on all three provided samples (results 4, 6, 0).
Ensure final program reads stdin, writes only the answer to stdout, no extra output.
Confirmed decomposition proof: N moves monotonically right with fixed cost T(N-1)-T(p-1); remaining problem reduces to subproblem on 1..N-1 with identical boundary costs.
